label.administrable_evidence: The Competitive State Wildlife Grant (C-SWG) Program provides Federal cost-sharing awards that help the State, Territory, and District of Columbia fish and wildlife agencies and their regional associations design and implement proactive conservation programs benefiting wildlife and their habitats.
label.match_evidence: The Federal share may not exceed 75 percent of the total project cost. The total project cost includes the requested Federal funds plus the required 25 percent non-federal cost share and any additional voluntary matching funds or other resources identified in the application.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The grant focuses on wildlife conservation and does not directly relate to any of the health and human services objectives outlined in the NC DHHS Strategic Plan.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The grant focuses on wildlife conservation and does not directly relate to any of the veteran services objectives outlined in the NC DMVA Strategic Plan.
